notes.title: Ver1.3.05
notes.content:
◆You can now check the detailed information of your equipment. Locking equipment can be done from the details screen.
◆A bug that prevented the temporary status increase in Extra Game from being reset has been fixed. The old score and new score versions have been separated to reflect this fix.
◆Other bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Ver1.3.05
notes.content:
◆You can now check the detailed information of your equipment. Locking equipment can be done from the details screen.
◆A bug that prevented the temporary status increase in Extra Game from being reset has been fixed. The old score and new score versions have been separated to reflect this fix.
◆Other bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Ver1.3.04
notes.content:
◆Some bosses have been adjusted.
◆Fixed a bug that caused the game to become unplayable when the button layout was changed.
◆Adjusted the color of some stages.

notes.title: Added Challenging Mode
notes.content:
◆Added the function to reset the scenario after defeating the hidden boss (Time Gate).

◆Added a challenging mode for those who want to fight strong enemies.
 You can start the game from the beginning with enhanced enemies.
 (You will need to clear a specific dungeon to play)

◆The maximum level for the normal game has been changed to 120 with this specification change.
 After resetting the scenario or starting the challenging mode, the maximum level will be 200.

◆The Difficulty of some bosses has been adjusted.

notes.title: Extra game mode added.
notes.content:
Extra game mode added.

[h2]Brief Description[/h2]
[olist]
[*] This is a mode for advanced players (recommended to play after completing the story).
[*] Attack the randomly generated dungeons and reach the bottom level to complete the game!
[*] Equipment, levels, and acquired items are reset each time.
[*] You can use magical ingredients to release an element. Elements released with magical ingredients are inherited even if you die.
[*] Magical ingredients are gone when you start the game. Use it up as much as possible.
[*] 
[*] 
[/olist]

I've already found some problems and will fix them in an update soon.
Also, I will be adding online rankings.

notes.title: Change the timing of adding the new game mode.
notes.content:
I am currently working on a new game mode.
It was supposed to be updated this month.
There are still some bugs and adjustments to be made, so I can't release it.

Therefore, I will postpone the update to September 2
I apologize to those of you who have been looking forward to this.

notes.title: About next update
notes.content:
I am currently implementing [b]new game mode[/b]
If all goes according to schedule, I'll have it done and updated by the end of this month.
Details of the new game mode.
[list]
[*] A more roguelike mode with permanent death. The balance will be adjusted according to the game content.
[*] 20 to 30 minutes per play.
[*] This is a test of skill for those who have completed the story mode.
[*] The main content is a story mode, so please think of it as a bonus mode.
[/list]

As for subsequent updates, I'm assuming [b]September or later[/b]
(The detailed date is not yet confirmed due to the current busy schedule)

[list]
[*]Added a feature that allows you to play the second week of the main game.
[*] [b]Change skin with your own image[/b]
[*] [b]Change the job of an existing character[/b]
[/list]

If you have any other requests, please contact me via the thread, twitter, or email.

notes.title: A new dungeon has been added!
notes.content:
The new dungeon "Dark Hole" has been added.
This is a special dungeon where the enemies become stronger as the player's level increases.
Also, you can get weapons with special properties that are only available here.

notes.title: Notice about the next update
notes.content:
[h1]Notice about the next update[/h1]

I am currently working on [b]new stages and bosses[/b]
An update will be coming soon!

As soon as the update is complete.
[b]I am going to start work on a new game mode.[/b]


I am also constantly working to improve the game's balance and visuals.
If you have suggestions on the content, please post it on the board.

notes.title: Regarding the problem with some gamepads not working.
notes.content:
Some controllers were not working when the game was launched, but this issue has been resolved for the [b]XBox360 controller[/b].
If you are having trouble getting it to work, restart Steam once and it will work from next time.

[b]If other controllers[/b] are not recognized, please follow the steps below to set them up.

[olist]
[*] Set Steam to BigPicture mode.
[*] Go to Settings (gear icon).
[*] Go to Controller settings
[*] Enable your controller's configuration support
[/olist]
